competitor.label: mcp-server-fetch reading the Kubernetes documentation (manifest-checking MCP servers need a live cluster; this is what agents use without one)

tasks.prompt: Which apiVersion must a CronJob manifest use on Kubernetes 1.25? Answer with the apiVersion only.
In which Kubernetes minor version was PodSecurityPolicy removed from the API? Answer like 1.NN.
Is `memory: 1GB` a valid Kubernetes resource quantity in a container's resources.limits? Answer yes or no.

The API server refuses this manifest. On which line is the invalid value? Answer with the line number only.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: ghcr.io/example/api:1.4.2
          imagePullPolicy: always
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 256Mi

Would this Pod be admitted in a namespace that enforces the restricted Pod Security Standard? Answer yes or no.

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: worker
spec:
  securityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
  containers:
    - name: worker
      image: ghcr.io/example/worker:2.0.0
      securityContext:
        allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
        capabilities:
          drop: [ALL]
In which Kubernetes minor version was flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta3 (FlowSchema) removed? Answer like 1.NN.
When an Ingress moves from extensions/v1beta1 to networking.k8s.io/v1, which field becomes required on every HTTP path? Answer with the field name only.
Does Kubernetes 1.37 still serve autoscaling/v2beta2 HorizontalPodAutoscaler? Answer yes or no.
What is the default value of a Deployment's spec.strategy.rollingUpdate.maxSurge? Answer with the value only.
Under the baseline Pod Security Standard, may a container add the NET_ADMIN capability? Answer yes or no.
